file-card.$description: FileCard. Component tokens reference SEMANTIC tokens through their CSS variables, so one declaration covers both themes. Graphite at rest; selection is the Qeet selected vocabulary (brand-subtle tint plus the brand indicator outline), failure is the danger border.

border-hover.$description: Hover on a card that opens: a visible decorative edge, paired with the hover elevation.

preview-background.$description: The preview well behind the file-type icon or thumbnail: sunken, so a white document thumbnail still reads as a page.

border-selected.$description: The selected outline: the Qeet indicator role (≥3:1), so selection never rests on the tint alone.
